notes.title: Demo Softlock Patch
notes.content:
If you found yourself unable to progress past the New Game screen, or had a softlock during any of our Tutorials, we've just released a small demo patch to fix those issues. 


 The Satoru fight will no longer softlock even under the most laggy conditions.
 Fixed an issue where some OS languages (such as Turkish) wouldn't allow you to create a new game.
 Being defeated by Kimothy and Satoru no longer breaks some SFX.


You can always find the latest updates to the demo build on our website.


If you have any bugs you'd like to report, click the "Bugs & Feedback" button in game.
Or let us know on discord.
